user_request: Read-only protocol spike. Drive @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk query() in streaming-input mode from a throwaway Node script and record what it really emits. Do not edit any repository source file; write only inside .planning/packets/claude-agent-sdk-pi-rpc/ and do not modify the pi-rpc-* files already there.
instructions: The SDK is installed at $(npm root -g)/@agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp/node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk (import it by absolute path; types in sdk.d.ts). The bridge source is $(npm root -g)/@agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp/dist. Read ONLY those, not the repository. Write a driver .mjs inside the allowed directory. Use cwd = the allowed directory, model 'haiku', and trivial prompts to keep spend small ('Reply with the single word ok'; 'Run the bash command: echo hi'; a long counting prompt for the interrupt). Do not use bypassPermissions; allow tools through canUseTool. Do not write to /tmp. Do not commit. If the SDK cannot authenticate, stop and report BLOCKED with the error text.
